answer: In this PoA design, identity verification runs a Wesolowski VDF: each claimant must complete a prescribed chain of modular squarings, with every output determining the next input. GPUs cannot eliminate each clone’s serial dependency by distributing it across processors, so simulating many identities multiplies sequential work and preserves a strict physical time bottleneck. The nebula, lagoon, and canyon labels provide no shortcut; only a valid delayed output and proof are accepted.
